question: For bounded amplitude-only local cylinders, does the unchanged finite stationary PAH semigroup converge uniformly on every compact external Markov-time interval to the identity action of the R-512 minimal-form semigroup, in the registered j-before-anchored-n order?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly immutable PAH-001, its original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs state and OMC-004 strip.
fixed_scope.observable_subspace: Bounded gauge- and anchor-invariant cylinders depending only on the finite local matter-amplitude coordinates r_v, with finite l1 Lipschitz constant L_f.
fixed_scope.finite_semigroup: P_nj(t)=exp(t L_nj) for the complete original finite generator and stationary law; no root deletion or fitted rate.
fixed_scope.target: T_min(t)=exp(-t K_min) for the exact R-512 minimal closed form selected in R-512.
fixed_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time on each compact interval [0,T] only.
fixed_scope.order: j tends to infinity at each fixed n first, followed by the registered anchored n exhaustion.
fixed_scope.normalization: Original labelled stationary normalization; no quotient, conditional averaging, direct sum or reweighting.

comparison.radial_increment: Every admissible TR move changes the local amplitude l1 coordinate by at most 2 h_j.
comparison.nonradial_increment: PH, LK and AP moves leave matter amplitudes unchanged, so an amplitude-only cylinder has zero increment on those roots.
comparison.source_bound: R-511 supplies ||L_TR,nj S_nj f||_2 <= 2 H_f L_f h_j with H_f <= 2 d_max |V_f| for n >= N(f).
comparison.semigroup_bound: Stationary reversibility gives L2 contraction, hence ||P_nj(t)S_nj f-S_nj f||_2 <= 2 T H_f L_f h_j for 0 <= t <= T.
comparison.correlation_bound: For bounded local f and amplitude-only g, the correlation defect is at most ||f||_2 2 T H_g L_g h_j.
comparison.target_identity: R-512 places the amplitude-only closed-form subspace H_rad in zero energy; the spectral semigroup consequence is T_min(t)g=g on H_rad.

radial_identity.condition: g belongs to the R-512 minimal form domain and Ebar(g,g)=0

acceptance.PASS_RESTRICTED: The finite radial residual, stationary L2 contraction, compact-time bound, target radial identity and j-before-anchored-n order all replay independently.
acceptance.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The restricted result is valid but the non-radial common-space/anchored-n route remains unproved.
acceptance.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact unchanged-PAH counterexample to the radial residual bound or the R-512 zero-energy identity would be negative.

verification_requirements: Primary exact rational fixture derived from support size, degree bound, Lipschitz constant, time horizon and h_j.
Non-importing independent fixture with different inputs and the same algebraic derivation.
Hostile mutations reject a nonzero non-radial increment, omitted L2 contraction, wrong h_j order, or physical promotion.
Lean finite declarations cover the jump, residual, compact-time and correlation inequalities; no measure construction is claimed formalized.
assumptions: R-511's exact finite radial L2 residual estimate and inverse-pair stationary bound hold at their pinned scope.
Each P_nj(t) is the complete stationary reversible finite PAH semigroup and is L2-contracting.
R-512's minimal closed form is the declared target and its zero-energy radial subspace gives the displayed spectral identity.
The amplitude-only cylinder is stabilized for n >= N(f) and retains the original labelled state and order.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized comparison map for non-radial cylinders across the anchored n spaces.
N2b arbitrary-sequence liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape, N2d minimal identification beyond the already-selected target, and the non-radial compact-time correlation transfer.
No claim that the restricted radial result supplies the full PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
next_single_question: Can one source-authorized common-space or path-space packet transfer the non-radial PH/LK/AP correlations to the same R-512 minimal semigroup while preserving the radial identity just proved?
revisit_condition: Reopen when a versioned source-authorized common-space/path-space packet is supplied or an exact PAH-specific defect appears in the radial residual, stationary contraction, or R-512 zero-energy identity; do not repeat physical-empty, BCC or Reading-H calculations.
non_claims: This is a restricted amplitude-only auxiliary result, not the full PAH-OMC-020 convergence theorem.
No non-radial PH/LK/AP anchored-n convergence, source-authorized common U_n, path law, N2b/N2c/N4/N2d closure or full semigroup identification.
No change to PAH-001 function, rates, state, mobility, carrier, regulator, normalization, external time or limit order.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
